duties.text: In May 2026 the cabinet cut the tax on new electric buses and trucks from as much as 61.8% to 15% VAT only, with customs, regulatory and supplementary duty, advance tax and advance income tax waived. Trucks qualify at 5 tonnes or more, buses at 17 seats or more.

The FY2026-27 budget extends this relief for electric buses and trucks into the next decade. It waives duties on imported materials for local electric bus and truck makers (VAT still applies), and removes the 39.75% tax on imported EV chargers.
make sure the HS code declared matches the commercial truck or bus classification, so the concession applies.

power.text: BERC’s EV and battery-charging tariff (from June 2026, low voltage): peak ৳14.20, off-peak ৳10.22, super off-peak ৳9.09 per unit; flat ৳11.36. 11 kV supply is a few paisa lower.
Diesel has been ৳135 a litre since 20 September 2026 (up from ৳115).
put depot chargers on a dedicated sub-meter and schedule charging in super off-peak hours.

batteries.text: The Hazardous Waste (E-waste) Management Rules, 2021 (Department of Environment) require producers, importers and recyclers to register with DoE and meet collection targets. EV traction batteries are not specifically listed, so contracts should set the terms.
write OEM take-back or buyback terms into the supply contract, and use only DoE-registered recyclers that issue recycling certificates for ESG audits.

finance.text: Bangladesh Bank cut the LC cash margin for car imports from 100% to a minimum of 50% from February 2025. For electric and hybrid vehicles, the margin is left to the bank and customer.
agree LC margin and tenor with the bank early. Confirmed LCs plus OEM warranty and spare-parts guarantees reduce risk for both sides.
